name: Apple Hill, High Hill Ranch
tagline: Add a Visit to High Hill Ranch to Your Fall Bucket List!
description: Apple Hill, High Hill Ranch is an agritourism farm in 901 High Hill Rd, CA, open to visitors for seasonal picking and farm activities. Offerings follow the growing season, so what is available changes through the year. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Availability follows the local growing season, so what is on offer changes through the year.
